companies.name: カラット・パッケージング

relations.text: Karatが10-Kで、主要顧客の一社に挙げる
relations.text_en: Karat names Chipotle among its blue-chip customers

source.label: Karat Packaging 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Our diverse and growing blue chip customer base includes well-known fast casual chains such as Applebee's Neighborhood Grill + Bar, Chili's Grill & Bar, PF Chang's China Bistro, Chipotle Mexican Grill, and Olive Garden

companies.name: グラフィック・パッケージング

relations.text: Graphic Packagingが10-Kで、外食の顧客の一社に挙げる
relations.text_en: Graphic Packaging names Chipotle among its quick-service restaurant customers

source.label: Graphic Packaging 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: Quick-service restaurant customers include Chick-fil-A, McDonald's, Wendy's, Panda Express, Dairy Queen, Chipotle, Panera and KFC.

companies.name: アルシャヤ・グループ

relations.text: 中東で提携先が運営するチポトレ店舗を展開(14店)
relations.text_en: Operates partner-run Chipotle restaurants in the Middle East (14)

source.label: Chipotle 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: As of December 31, 2025, we had 14 international partner-operated Chipotle restaurants in the Middle East in partnership with the Alshaya Group

relations.text_en: Holds Series B preferred stock (private company)

source.label: Chipotle 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: As of December 31, 2025, we held 5,819 shares of the Series B Preferred Stock of Hyphen.

relations.text: Sweetgreenが10-Kで、競合の筆頭に挙げる
relations.text_en: Sweetgreen lists Chipotle first among its competitors

source.label: Sweetgreen 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: Among our competitors are a number of multi-unit, multi-market, fast-food, or fast-casual restaurant concepts, some of which are expanding nationally, including companies like Chipotle, CAVA, McDonald's, Panera Bread, and Shake Shack

relations.text: CAVAが雇用契約で、競合の筆頭に挙げる
